name: Doing The Right Thing
overview: Scripture calls believers to prioritize doing what is just and righteous above outward religious acts, emphasizing that doing justice and judgment pleases the LORD more than sacrifice (Proverbs 21:3). God commands His people to advocate for the voiceless and vulnerable, such as the oppressed, fatherless, and widows, demonstrating active compassion and fairness (Proverbs 31:8; Isaiah 1:17). True discipleship requires wholehearted devotion to God alone, rejecting divided loyalties, and trusting Him to provide for our needs without anxiety (Luke 16:13; Matthew 6:25). Those who endure persecution for righteousness' sake are blessed and assured of the kingdom of heaven (Matthew 5:10).
